description: Discover a perfect blend of style and comfort in our charming 70m² loft in the heart of the vibrant Roquette district, Paris 11. With its three spacious bedrooms, it can comfortably accommodate up to 8 people. Ideally located close to the Place de la Nation, this apartment is the perfect base from which to explore the many charms of the French capital.The spaceCome and discover our authentic 70 m² apartment in the legendary Roquette district. As soon as you step inside, you'll be seduced by its warm, friendly atmosphere. What's more, this apartment combines comfort and elegance, with meticulous decoration and quality finishes. Whether you're getting together with friends, family or colleagues, this space is sure to make your stay in Paris a pleasant one.To guarantee you the perfect vacation or business trip, we've meticulously studied every detail of the apartment. Our loft apartment features ..:- A fully-equipped independent kitchen (refrigerator, induction hob, microwave, kettle, coffee machine, oven, washing machine...), designed to meet your most demanding needs.- A comfortable living room with sofa bed, perfect for relaxing after a day exploring Paris.- Three bedrooms with double beds and a high level of comfort for a restful night's sleep.- Two stylish and comfortable bathrooms.- Two separate WCs.- Plenty of optimized storage space to organize your belongings.- Television and high-speed Internet connection (WIFI).- Bed linen and towels provided.Guest accessYou'll have access to the whole apartment, so you'll feel right at home.Other things to noteA bank imprint will be requested before you arrive at the accommodation, except for bookings made via Airbnb.
